name: fonts
title: TanStack Start font pipeline
author: hbmartin
description: Self-hosted Google fonts with metric-matched fallbacks, wired into Tailwind v4's @theme. One Vite plugin; your styles.css and __root.tsx are never touched.
docs:
Two steps left.

1. Add fonts() to vite.config.ts, BEFORE tailwindcss() — both are enforce:'pre', so array order decides:

     import { fonts } from 'tailwind-font-kit'

     plugins: [
       nitro(),
       fonts(),
       tailwindcss(),
       tanstackStart(),
       viteReact(),
     ]

2. Edit fonts.config.mjs to name the fonts you want.

Already have fonts wired up? Run `npx tss-fonts adopt` instead — it reads the Google @import and --font-* vars you already have, writes them into fonts.config.mjs, and removes them from your CSS. It prints a diff and supports --dry-run.

Note: shadcn cannot edit vite.config.ts (no codemods, by design), which is why step 1 is manual. `npx tss-fonts init` will do it for you.
